description: Phase 6 — certificates & sharing derived entirely from real completed-progress data. Independent of FEAT-001. CRITICAL: no completion timestamp is recorded anywhere today (ProgressionState has none; RewardsState stores only streak.lastLocalDateYYYYMMDD), so this feature adds a per-level completion timestamp recorded exactly on the real false->true edge of isLevelComplete (via the existing deriveCompletionEvents), and the certificate derives its completion date from that recorded value. A level completed BEFORE this feature shipped (no recorded timestamp) shows completion date as unknown rather than fabricating Date.now(). A certificate is generated ONLY for a level that passes isLevelComplete. The reference id is a deterministic LOCAL string (no verification URL, no identity proof, no auto-posting). PDF/sharing use exact SDK 54 pins.
steps: Record completion timestamps. In src/persistence/store.ts add completedLevels: Record<string, number> to the single-key document (key `${trackId}/${levelId}` -> epoch ms); guard: values must be finite positive integers, malformed entries dropped with one console.warn, default {}. In src/ui/context/ProgressionProvider.tsx, inside the existing completeLesson and recordMasteryResult transactions, after computing the next progression, resolve the Level via findTrack/findLevel (catalogLookup) and call deriveCompletionEvents(before, after, level, trackId) from src/domain/rewards; for each emitted 'level-completed' event whose key is not already present in completedLevels, record the current time once (monotonic — never overwrite an existing timestamp). Prefer an injected clock consistent with the existing provider pattern (Date.now() in production). Expose completedLevels on the context. Do not change unrelated behavior.

Create src/domain/certificates/document.ts (pure TS; no react/react-native/AsyncStorage/Node-IO imports). Export: buildCertificateReferenceId(trackId, levelId, displayName): string = `goalie-<trackId>-<levelId>-<djb2hex(displayName||'')>` (deterministic, stable across calls, differs by display name); interface CertificateData { referenceId: string; studentDisplayName: string|null; trackTitle: string; levelTitle: string; levelId: string; completionDateEpochMs: number|null; completionDateUnknown: boolean; skills: string[]; disclaimer: string }; class CertificateError extends Error; buildCertificateData(state, track, level, displayName, completedLevels): CertificateData that THROWS CertificateError unless isLevelComplete(state, level, track.id), sets completionDateEpochMs from completedLevels[`${track.id}/${level.id}`] (null + completionDateUnknown:true when absent, NEVER now()), derives skills from real content (level.objective + each lesson.objective), and sets disclaimer EXACTLY to 'Completion certificate — not academic credit or an accredited professional credential.'. Add buildCertificateHtml(data): string returning a self-contained one-page HTML document with ORIGINAL Goalie branding only (no imitation of any other app), handling a long studentDisplayName via CSS wrap/truncation (never data loss), containing the exact disclaimer, track/level titles, and reference id, and containing NO http/verification-URL claim. Add buildSharePostText(data): string returning editable LinkedIn/social copy naming the track/level with NO URL and NO verification claim. Keep the existing buildCertificatePreview in src/domain/certificates/index.ts for the list view.

Add __tests__/certificate-document.test.ts: an incomplete level makes buildCertificateData throw CertificateError (never a certificate); buildCertificateReferenceId is identical across repeated calls and differs when displayName differs; completionDateEpochMs comes from completedLevels when present and is null + completionDateUnknown when absent (assert it is never Date.now()); buildCertificateHtml returns a non-empty string containing the exact disclaimer text, the level and track titles, and the reference id, and NOT containing 'http' or any verification-URL wording; a very long display name is still present in the HTML (truncation is CSS, not data loss); buildSharePostText contains the track and level and no URL.

Pin native modules via `npx expo install expo-print expo-sharing expo-file-system` (must resolve to expo-print ~15.0.8, expo-sharing ~14.0.8, expo-file-system ~19.0.24 for SDK 54) and confirm they appear in package.json dependencies with those versions. If the expo CLI cannot run in-env, add the exact pins to package.json manually and run `npm install`, then verify the lockfile. Add src/ui/certificates/pdf.ts (UI layer, effects only): generateCertificatePdf(html: string): Promise<string> using expo-print printToFileAsync; savePdf(uri: string): Promise<string> relocating into a stable documents location via expo-file-system; sharePdf(uri: string): Promise<void> guarded by Sharing.isAvailableAsync() (honest 'sharing unavailable' when false; user cancellation is a clean no-op, not an error). The domain stays pure; all native effects live here.

Upgrade the certificate screens. Add a Certificate detail route (or extend the existing 'Certificate' screen with a selected level): modify src/ui/navigation/RootNavigator.tsx to add a route param for the selected level (e.g. CertificateDetail: { trackId: string; levelId: LevelId }) and register a new src/ui/screens/CertificateDetailScreen.tsx. Keep src/ui/screens/CertificateScreen.tsx listing ONLY truly-complete levels (unchanged honesty) and make each complete level open the detail view. The detail view builds buildCertificateData (incomplete is unreachable from the UI and also blocked in the domain), renders the honest completion date or 'completion date not recorded' when completionDateUnknown, previews the generated PDF/HTML, offers Save and Share (native share sheet via sharePdf, honest-unavailable when Sharing is not available), and shows an editable, copyable social post from buildSharePostText with NO auto-posting, NO public profile, NO verification URL. Generation works offline (all local). Save/share cancellation is handled silently.

Add certificate + completion-timestamp tests to __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx (mock expo-print, expo-sharing, expo-file-system so no real native call is made): completing a level records a completedLevels timestamp that survives a reopen (remount); the certificate detail for a complete level renders the recorded date, the exact disclaimer, and the copyable post, and offers Share only when Sharing.isAvailableAsync() resolves true (assert both branches); an INCOMPLETE level never reaches generation (omitted from the list / detail refuses).
acceptance_criteria: src/domain/certificates/document.ts is pure (npx tsc --noEmit passes; no react/react-native/AsyncStorage import) and all behaviors covered by __tests__/certificate-document.test.ts.
buildCertificateData throws for an incomplete level and NEVER fabricates a completion date (null + completionDateUnknown when no recorded timestamp exists).
The reference id is deterministic and contains no verification URL anywhere in the generated HTML or post text.
package.json pins expo-print@~15.0.8, expo-sharing@~14.0.8, expo-file-system@~19.0.24 and `npx tsc --noEmit` passes.
The certificate detail screen previews a PDF, saves, shares via the native sheet (honest-unavailable when Sharing is unavailable), and shows an editable copyable post with no auto-posting.
A per-level completion timestamp is recorded on the real completion edge and survives reopen: `npx jest screens.smoke` passes.
`npx jest certificate-document` passes and the full `npx jest` suite is green.
verification: npx jest screens.smoke  (passes; completion-timestamp + certificate flow)
grep the pinned versions in package.json to confirm expo-print ~15.0.8 / expo-sharing ~14.0.8 / expo-file-system ~19.0.24 (version pin confirmation only; functional proof is the jest suites above)
findings: COMPLETED. New files: src/domain/certificates/document.ts (pure: exports CERTIFICATE_DISCLAIMER const = 'Completion certificate — not academic credit or an accredited professional credential.', CertificateData {referenceId, studentDisplayName:string|null, trackTitle, levelTitle, levelId, completionDateEpochMs:number|null, completionDateUnknown:boolean, skills:string[], disclaimer}, class CertificateError, buildCertificateReferenceId(trackId,levelId,displayName)=`goalie-<trackId>-<levelId>-<djb2hex(displayName||'')>` (deterministic, differs by name, no URL), buildCertificateData(state,track,level,displayName,completedLevels) THROWS CertificateError unless isLevelComplete; completionDateEpochMs from completedLevels[`${track.id}/${level.id}`] else null+completionDateUnknown (never now()); skills = [level.objective, ...lessons.map(l=>l.objective)]; buildCertificateHtml(data) self-contained one-page HTML, original Goalie branding, CSS wrap/truncate for long names (overflow-wrap:anywhere + max-height, no data loss), contains exact disclaimer/titles/referenceId, no http; buildSharePostText(data) editable social copy naming track+level, no URL/verification). src/ui/certificates/pdf.ts (UI effects: generateCertificatePdf(html)->uri via expo-print printToFileAsync; savePdf(uri)->documents uri via new File/Paths.document copy (SDK 54 File/Paths API); sharePdf(uri) guarded by Sharing.isAvailableAsync() throwing SharingUnavailableError when false, cancellation is clean no-op). src/ui/screens/CertificateDetailScreen.tsx (new route CertificateDetail:{trackId,levelId:LevelId}; builds buildCertificateData, renders honest date or 'Completion date not recorded', Save + conditional Share (only when isAvailableAsync true, else honest 'Sharing is unavailable on this device' copy), editable copyable TextInput social post, no auto-posting/URL; incomplete level -> domain throws -> ErrorState, no certificate). Tests: __tests__/certificate-document.test.ts (12), Phase-6 block added to __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx (mocks expo-print/expo-sharing/expo-file-system; setShareAvailable() toggles both Share branches). STORE: PersistedData gained completedLevels: Record<string,number> (key `${trackId}/${levelId}` -> epoch ms), default {} in defaultPersistedData; guardV2 accepts absent/null (->{}), drops entries that are not finite positive integers (epoch 0 is dropped per the positive-integer rule) with one warn 'goalie: dropped malformed completed level'; v1->v2 migrate carries {} via defaultPersistedData base. PROVIDER: ProgressionProvider exposes completedLevels: Record<string,number>; new internal recordCompletions(prev, events) records clock.nowEpochMs() for each 'level-completed' event key NOT already present (monotonic, never overwrites); wired into both completeLesson and recordMasteryResult single-key transactions after deriveCompletionEvents. ROUTES: RootNavigator added CertificateDetail route + screen; CertificateScreen now renders each complete level as a Pressable that navigates to CertificateDetail (list still shows ONLY isLevelComplete levels). pdf helper API: generateCertificatePdf(html:string):Promise<string>, savePdf(uri:string):Promise<string>, sharePdf(uri:string):Promise<void> (throws SharingUnavailableError). Pins in package.json: expo-print ~15.0.8, expo-sharing ~14.0.8, expo-file-system ~19.0.24 (via npx expo install). Verification all green: tsc exit 0, jest 161/161 (13 suites), lint 0 errors, catalog valid. The whole-suite console.warn 'dropped malformed completed level' is benign: rewards-wiring smoke tests use a FakeClock whose default epoch is 0, so the recorded 0 is correctly dropped on reopen per the positive-integer guard.
